local_context.value: Winter Haven (Wikipedia): average rainfall 46.12 in/yr; June-September averages 26.63 in, more than half the annual total; terrain 'flatland interspersed with gently rolling hills'; fifty lakes within city borders, most sinkhole 'solution lakes'; headwaters of the Peace River; four historic districts (Interlaken, Pope Avenue, Winter Haven Heights, downtown), with Interlaken homes mostly 1910s-1920s Colonial Revival (Wikipedia/NPS); 2020 Census: 21,902 housing units. NWS Tampa Bay: West Central Florida rainy season runs May 25 to October 10, with frequent thunderstorms, lightning, damaging winds and heavy rainfall.

neighborhoods.value: Interlaken Historic Residential District (NRHP 2002); Winter Haven Heights Historic Residential District (NRHP 2000); Pope Avenue Historic District (NRHP 2001); Downtown Winter Haven Historic District (NRHP 2002). Only 4 named historic districts found; no official city neighborhood list found.
